raw_output:
alias: 回家后播放音乐
description: 当检测到有人回家时，自动播放音乐
triggers:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: lock.front_door
    to: 'unlocked'
conditions: []
actions:
  - service: media_player.play_media
    target:
      entity_id: media_player.living_speaker
    data:
      media_content_id: 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5qap5zrrfgY'
      media_content_type: 'music'
mode: single
